python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Treasury data (June values in millions)
europe_1991 = 268166
latam_1991 = 337565
europe_1996 = 426245
latam_1996 = 443872

# Germany's nominal GDP in billions (World Bank data, rounded to 2 decimal points)
germany_gdp_1991 = 1875.79
germany_gdp_1996 = 2506.58

# Linear regression with Europe as predictor of Latin America
# Using two points: (268166, 337565) and (426245, 443872)
x1, y1 = europe_1991, latam_1991
x2, y2 = europe_1996, latam_1996

slope = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1)
intercept = y1 - slope * x1

print(f"Regression: Latin America = {slope:.6f} * Europe + {intercept:.2f}")

# Germany's percentage growth rate
germany_growth_rate = (germany_gdp_1996 - germany_gdp_1991) / germany_gdp_1991
print(f"Germany GDP growth rate: {germany_growth_rate:.6f} ({germany_growth_rate*100:.2f}%)")

# Apply growth rate to June 1991 Europe value (counterfactual)
counterfactual_europe = europe_1991 * (1 + germany_growth_rate)
print(f"Counterfactual Europe: {counterfactual_europe:.2f}")

# Use regression to predict Latin America
predicted_latam = slope * counterfactual_europe + intercept
print(f"Predicted Latin America: {predicted_latam:.2f}")

# Calculate absolute difference from actual June 1996 Latin America value
absolute_diff = abs(predicted_latam - latam_1996)
print(f"Absolute difference: {absolute_diff:.2f}")

# Express as percentage of actual June 1996 value
percentage_diff = (absolute_diff / latam_1996) * 100
print(f"Percentage difference: {percentage_diff:.6f}%")

# U.S. total liabilities growth ratio (Europe + Latin America & Caribbean)
us_total_1991 = europe_1991 + latam_1991
us_total_1996 = europe_1996 + latam_1996
us_growth_ratio = us_total_1996 / us_total_1991
print(f"U.S. total liabilities growth ratio: {us_growth_ratio:.6f}")

# Germany's nominal GDP growth ratio
germany_gdp_ratio = germany_gdp_1996 / germany_gdp_1991
print(f"Germany GDP growth ratio: {germany_gdp_ratio:.6f}")

# Ratio of U.S. growth to Germany GDP growth
growth_ratio = us_growth_ratio / germany_gdp_ratio
print(f"Growth ratio (U.S./Germany): {growth_ratio:.6f}")

# Final calculation
final_result = percentage_diff * growth_ratio
print(f"Final result: {final_result:.6f}")
print(f"Rounded to 2 decimal places: {final_result:.2f}")
EOF
